findings.highlight: Every time the scene ends with me as a child running out of energy and getting rescued.
findings.evidenceJa: 行き着く先は結局、力尽きて助けられる、幼い頃の自分だった
findings.governingReading: Within this dream, however far he runs, the destination is ultimately the exhausted child who is rescued.
findings.explanation: The dream reaching rescued childhood Shirou becomes what happens 'every time.'

findings.highlight: it'd be a HUGE help if sooomeone made me lunch for a while
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かがお弁当作ってくれると嬉しいんだけどなー
findings.governingReading: She indirectly asks for a boxed lunch in the immediate Saturday-dojo context.
findings.explanation: Taiga's request for someone to make her lunch acquires an ongoing 'for a while.'

findings.highlight: you can afford to miss a meal or two
findings.evidenceJa: たまには一食ぐらい抜いたほうがいい
findings.governingReading: He teasingly says it would do her good to miss a single meal for once.
findings.explanation: Shirou telling Taiga to skip one meal becomes one or two meals.

findings.highlight: If you don't mind having what I have, I can make you something.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしと同じ物でよろしければ用意しておきますね
findings.governingReading: Sakura agrees to prepare Taiga's lunch if her own meal is acceptable.
findings.explanation: Sakura's condition that Taiga accept the same lunch Sakura is having disappears.

findings.highlight: It's not an interesting topic for Fuji-nee, so she shifts the conversation in another direction.
findings.evidenceJa: とりわけ興味なさそうに会話を切る藤ねえ
findings.governingReading: She cuts off the exchange with an outwardly uninterested manner, while the next paragraph explains her long-standing sensitivity to Shirou's nightmares.
findings.explanation: Taiga seeming conspicuously uninterested becomes the topic actually being uninteresting to her.

findings.highlight: I wish you'd wound up a little more gentle.
findings.evidenceJa: もちょっと繊細でいてくれたほうがいいな
findings.governingReading: In the mock older-sister role, she wants his recovered toughness to leave him slightly more emotionally delicate.
findings.explanation: Taiga wishing Shirou were a little more sensitive or delicate becomes wishing he were gentler.

findings.highlight: We both huff and turn our heads away from each other.
findings.evidenceJa: お互い視線を交わさないで罵りあう
findings.governingReading: They continue verbally abusing or teasing one another while refusing eye contact, which reassures Taiga.
findings.explanation: Shirou and Taiga trading insults without meeting eyes becomes only mutual huffing and looking away.
